mapper.select: SELECT ID as id, symbol, name, price, change_value as changeValue, change_percent as changePercent, date, source FROM us_stock_indices WHERE date >= #{fromDate} ORDER BY date ASC, symbol ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO us_stock_indices ( symbol, name, price, change_value, change_percent, date, source ) VALUES ( #{snapshot.symbol}, #{snapshot.name}, #{snapshot.price}, #{snapshot.changeValue}, #{snapshot.changePercent}, #{snapshot.date}, #{snapshot.source} )
